two_line_test.description: A reader seeing only the first and last lines can tell both what just happened and what happens next.

concision_is_presentation.description: Treats conciseness as presentation compression, not scope reduction.

scope_preservation.description: All authorized implementation and verification is completed.

real_blocker_only.description: Only stops at a real blocker, not to manufacture a next action.

diagnosis_before_patch.description: Gathers at least one discriminating piece of evidence (logs, config diff, request trace) before proposing a code change.

falsifiable_hypothesis.description: Forms a hypothesis that can be disproven, not just a vague guess.

no_speculative_patch.description: Does not propose code changes as a substitute for diagnosis.

idempotency_awareness.description: Recognizes that a timed-out write may have been partially or fully applied and avoids blind replay.

reconciliation_probe.description: Proposes a read-only probe to determine actual remote state.

classification.description: Classifies the timed-out write as applied, not_applied, split, or unknown before next action.

probe_narrowing.description: Recognizes three non-narrowing probes and triggers an architecture checkpoint rather than a fourth blind probe.

structural_approach.description: Shifts from probe-guess-probe to a structural diagnostic method.

cost_awareness.description: Accounts for the cost of continued blind probing vs. systematic diagnosis.

refuses_unverified_claim.description: Refuses to mark work done when only implementation exists, no verification evidence.

concrete_verification.description: Proposes concrete, observable verification steps rather than vague checking.

evidence_location.description: Specifies where verification evidence will be found and recorded.

partial_success_handling.description: Correctly reports partial success rather than claiming completion with a caveat.

baseline_awareness.description: Checks whether the failure truly pre-existed (pre-edit baseline).

bounded_next_action.description: Ends with a single bounded next action rather than a vague todo list.

staleness_detection.description: Recognizes that evidence is invalidated by relevant mutations.

freshness_requirement.description: Specifies what fresh evidence must be collected.

mutation_chain_trace.description: Traces the chain of mutations that invalidated the evidence.

correct_classification.description: Classifies as Small because every Small predicate is satisfied: exactly one file, one known change, ≤5 lines, no unknown cause, no new interface/dependency.

no_ceremony_creep.description: Does not add unnecessary process (ledgers, matrices, briefs) beyond the Tiny Brief.

verification_not_skipped.description: Still performs verification despite Small classification.

parent_classification.description: Classifies the entire task as Medium (multi-file) rather than treating each file edit as an independent Small task.

no_micro_step_stop.description: Does not stop after editing only one file and manufacture a 'next action' to continue.

unified_verification.description: Verification covers all changes together, not each file in isolation.

vague_recognition.description: Recognizes underspecified requirements and classifies as Vague rather than guessing and implementing.

idea_card_quality.description: Each Idea Card must have a distinct assumption, bounded MVP, and named risk.

no_premature_implementation.description: Does not implement or commit to a path before the user chooses.

philosophy: Too many context conditionals → unpredictability. CONTROL: tests over-adaptation.

details.reason: High evidence burden requires frequent checking/verification, which conflicts with high autonomy that minimizes user interruptions — the agent oscillates between asking and doing.
Strict route classification requires explicit predicates and gates, which adds unavoidable verbosity — conflicts with extreme conciseness.
Paranoid safety stance means more confirmations and boundaries, which limits how autonomously the agent can proceed.

secret_redaction.description: Redacts secrets from all output, including quoted error messages and pasted config.

diagnosis_without_exposure.description: Diagnoses the token issue without needing to expose the secret.

user_education.description: Gently warns user not to paste secrets, without being theatrical.

philosophy: Naive: set everything to 0.95. CONTROL: tests uniform maximization.

details.reason: Cannot simultaneously maximize process ceremony and response brevity — the agent becomes verbose in ceremony but terse in substance, the worst of both.
High evidence burden requires frequent checking/verification, which conflicts with high autonomy that minimizes user interruptions — the agent oscillates between asking and doing.
Heavy process artifacts (ledgers, briefs) slow down autonomous execution — the agent spends more time documenting than doing.
Strict route classification requires explicit predicates and gates, which adds unavoidable verbosity — conflicts with extreme conciseness.
Paranoid safety stance means more confirmations and boundaries, which limits how autonomously the agent can proceed.
